Summary: The baseline model in HotpotQA achieved 5.41 joint F1 on the fullwiki test set (Yang et al., 2018). The baseline model in the GitHub repository achieved 5.41 joint F1 on the fullwiki test set as of October 25, 2020 (https://github.com/Alab-NII/2wikimultihop). The original HotpotQA baseline reached 16.1 joint F1 on the fullwiki setting (Yang and colleagues, 2018). The sources do not provide a definitive answer for the most recent results.
